# INS Overseas — llms.txt
# https://ins-overseas.com
# Format: https://llmstxt.org/

> INS Overseas is India's leading manufacturer and wholesale exporter of handmade leather journals, cotton rag paper, seed paper, and artisan gift products. Founded in 1995 in Sanganer, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. A four-generation family craft business exporting to 40+ countries worldwide. MOQ 200 units. Custom OEM/private-label available.

## Key Facts

- **Entity type**: Manufacturer & wholesale exporter (B2B)
- **Founded**: 1995
- **Location**: Jain Nasiya Road, Near Jain Hostel, Sanganer, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302029, India
- **Contact**: Sezan@ins-overseas.com | WhatsApp: +91 96804 78483
- **Export markets**: USA, UK, EU, Australia, Japan, Canada, UAE, and 35+ more countries
- **Certifications**: Eco-certified materials (100% recycled cotton, zero tree paper)
- **Production capacity**: Largest handmade paper manufacturer in India

## Product Lines

- **Handmade Leather Journals**: Full-grain buffalo leather, hand-stitched bindings, deckle-edge cotton rag paper inserts. Sizes: A4, A5, A6, pocket. MOQ 200 units.
- **Leather Bags**: Crossbody bags, totes, pouches. Full-grain leather. MOQ 150 units.
- **Handmade Paper Gift Boxes**: Recycled cotton rag paper, gold foil accents. MOQ 200 units.
- **Paper Gift Bags**: Recycled cotton, ribbon handles. MOQ 800 units.
- **Seed Paper (Plantable)**: Wildflower-embedded sheets, biodegradable. MOQ 1500 units.
- **Deckle Edge Paper**: 120–300 gsm cotton rag, fountain-pen and watercolour grade. MOQ 200 units.
- **Handblock Print Fabric**: Natural dye, Sanganer motifs, 100% cotton. MOQ 200 units.
